s: December 14, 2023 - A: Both words mean teacher, but are not a reversal of the same characters. The “han” is the same, meaning an example, model or pattern. The “shi” in shihan means teacher or master. The “shi” that’s used in hanshi means (gentle)man, samurai or warrior, or scholar.
